title: Multi-tenant isolation is not implemented for the core resource graph
expected_behavior: tenant_owned resources scoped by tenant_id
observed_behavior: 49 core tables reconciled into exactly three mutually exclusive categories: 16 authoritative_tenant_path, 28 user_only_path, 5 no_authoritative_ownership_path (49/49, no table in two categories). data_centre_twins - the root of the twin graph - is user_only_path: scoped by created_by_user, no org_id, no FK to organizations. Every twin child table (telemetry, kpi snapshots, carbon, financial, sovereignty events, simulation runs) inherits from that user-only root, so 28 of the 49 core tables have no tenant path at all.
impact: core facilities/twins/telemetry/simulations/recommendations/integrations have no non-forgeable tenant ownership path; tenant sharing would require widening policies
root_cause: core graph never adopted the organizations/profiles.org_id model that already exists in the schema
recommended_remediation: add a non-forgeable tenant path (direct tenant_id or secure parent inheritance) to the core resource graph; the schema CAN express tenant ownership today

title: Shared handler authLevel="admin" grants a service-role client without establishing caller identity
expected_behavior: an "admin" authorization level validates the bearer token and asserts an admin role before returning a privileged client
observed_behavior: _shared/auth.ts authLevel:'admin' returns a service-role client with no token verification, no role lookup and no tenant predicate. 8 deployable functions declare it. Deployed gateway verify_jwt defaults to true (only green-dc-recommend and dsx-ingest are overridden in config.toml), so 0 endpoints are anonymous_unprotected and 8 are authenticated_without_admin_authorization. ops-heartbeat performs a service-role UPDATE on a caller-supplied agents row; zapier-webhook performs a service-role UPDATE/INSERT selected by a caller-controlled app_key with signature verification left as a TODO.
impact: any authenticated non-admin caller obtains RLS-bypassing cross-tenant reads on agents/roi_snapshots/agent_runs/agent_conversations/environments/system_health, and cross-tenant writes on agents, heartbeats, integrations and integration_logs. Split into F-15a (structural), F-15b/F-15c (CRITICAL writes), F-15d (HIGH reads).
root_cause: the authorization level names a privilege tier but implements only a client-construction strategy
recommended_remediation: enforce identity, role and tenant predicates before constructing any service-role client; remove the admin shortcut from _shared/auth.ts; re-verify each of the 8 endpoints individually.

impact: CI and the deployed build resolve dependencies through two solvers; an advisory fixed in one lockfile can persist in the other

recommended_remediation: delete bun.lockb, choose one solver for CI and hosting, and run the advisory scan in CI against a registry that serves the audit endpoint
